## GPS checklist
- [ ] Reasonably exhaustive search, logged in `questions/Q-n/log.md` (negative searches included)
- [ ] Every new fact cites a `[[S-...]]` source with an Evidence Explained citation
- [ ] Sources, information, and evidence classified in `analysis.md`
- [ ] Conflicts resolved or listed as open
- [ ] Written conclusion in `proof.md` (required for `proven`)
- [ ] Adversarial review in `review.md` (required for `proven`)
- [ ] `python3 tools/validate.py .` passes
- [ ] No living-person details or DNA match identities in public files
